name: Windows Widgets
description: Author and publish native Windows Adaptive Card widgets from bot-pushed snapshots, timestamped history and explicit lighting controls.

nodeId.description: Exact paired Windows node ID. Never inferred from the first connected device.

allowedSourceUrls.description: Administrator-approved exact public HTTPS JSON URLs for new source adapters. Not agent-editable consent. Responses stay in local widget state; use only sources you are authorized to display.
